summary_zh: 泰國媒體報導網路攻擊平均每日12次，製造業名列10大高風險產業，工廠資安成為今日新痛點。政府擬將巴真武里流域劃為污染控制區，加強重金屬檢測與源頭工廠稽查，環保合規壓力持續。另Garmin宣布於春武里府設立泰國首座工廠，預計2026年第四季投產。
summary_en: Thai media report 12 cyberattacks a day on average, with manufacturing among the 10 highest-risk industries. Prachinburi river basin may become a pollution control zone with stricter heavy-metal testing and factory audits. Garmin plans its first Thai plant in Chonburi, producing from Q4 2026.
